name: estimate_property_value
description: Automated Valuation Model (AVM): estimate market value using comparable sales with age, bed/bath, and lot-size adjustments. Returns value, confidence range, comparables used, and methodology breakdown. Not a formal appraisal.

address.description: Full property address (e.g., '123 Main St, Austin, TX 78701')

property_type.description: Type of property (One of: single_family, condo, townhouse, multi_family, land)

name: get_comparables
description: Find comparable property sales near an address, ordered by similarity score, with per-comp adjustments (sqft, beds, baths, time) and summary statistics.

address.description: Subject property address to find comparables for

max_results.description: Maximum number of comparable properties to return (1-20) (Default: 10)

name: generate_cma_report
description: Generate a full Comparative Market Analysis (CMA) report: subject property, 5 comparable sales with itemized adjustments, active listings, value reconciliation, and suggested list/competitive/aspirational pricing.

address.description: Full address of the subject property

name: calculate_replacement_cost
description: Estimate property value using the cost approach: replacement cost new, physical/functional/external depreciation, land value, and site improvements. Most reliable for newer or unique structures.

property_type.description: Type of property (One of: single_family, condo, townhouse, multi_family, commercial)

quality_grade.description: Construction quality (One of: economy, standard, good, excellent, luxury)
